If the capex that funds 55% of Data Center revenue is cut even 10-15% in 2027, the FY28 peak-cycle EPS base evaporates and the 13-14x forward multiple re-rates to a trough P/E on falling earnings. Financed demand (NVIDIA buying its own revenue via the OpenAI stake) flatters the picture.

Forward PEG ~0.2 is extraordinarily cheap if the cycle runs even two more years.
